ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90:10 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central contiguous white field extending from the peduncle to the trailing edge. Low-intensity black pigmentation is mapped strictly to the trailing edge perimeter (approx. 5-10 pixel depth) and the extreme lateral tips. Multiple discrete, low-radius black circular spots are distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 55 degrees and a deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations characterized by sharp peaks and jagged valleys across the entire linear boundary of the trailing edge, most pronounced on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature meeting at the median notch, with a strong convex upward sweep along the lateral margins terminating in sharp, recurved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several dark, roughly circular pixel clusters (approx. 5-8 units) scattered semi-symmetrically on the interior white surface of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically-oriented dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower-left quadrant of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable dark, irregular vertical marking/scarring at the central base of the fluke where it joins the peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-intensity white pixel noise (water spray) obscuring the lower central surface and creating localized glare on the trailing edge.
